dedupe_keys.name: city camera trajectory data extraction and evaluation code

description: The Tsinghua FIB Lab publishes code used to recover city vehicle trajectories from traffic-camera visual embeddings and to evaluate the resulting paths. Its own public GitHub repository declares an MIT licence and gives Python requirement guidance. The describing article links this code to the Shenzhen and Jinan trajectory collection, including road-network CSVs and vehicle re-identification tests. A transport modeller can inspect the recovery steps before treating camera-derived paths as calibration data. A caveat is that running the full pipeline depends on the visual embedding inputs, camera coverage and matching choices; the public code does not make unobserved road movements ground truth. The released trajectory data have a separate Figshare collection DOI. I read the own GitHub metadata, README and article code statement without cloning the repository, installing dependencies, handling camera video or reproducing the reported trajectories. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
